name: @orbb/api
description: ORBB edge API (M3-A): the real /v1 Hono router on a Cloudflare Worker — standardized error envelope + request ids, the principal verifier seam, person-scoped resources (me, intents, observations, evidence metadata) over injected repository interfaces, A24 Idempotency-Key middleware, and the A26 OpenAPI 3.1 document. Builds with `wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir=dist` (no credentials).
